name: require-on-rails
description: An opinionated Roblox Luau utility extension to simplify working with complex codebase hierarchies

commands.title: Add Import Definition to All Files
Rewrite All Requires to Current Style

enumDescriptions: Generate basename aliases into .luaurc and resolve them at runtime with the RequireOnRails Luau module.
Write full require paths into source at edit time. No aliases are generated and .luaurc is never written by the extension.
require-on-rails.mode.description: How requires are resolved. 'dynamic' generates basename aliases resolved at runtime; 'explicit' writes full, statically-resolvable paths into your source at edit time.

enumDescriptions: Alias-rooted paths like @Shared/Stuff/myModule, using the longest matching alias from .luaurc. Still requires the RequireOnRails Luau module at runtime (Roblox does not support .luaurc aliases natively).
Relative paths like ./Stuff/myModule, supported natively by Roblox string requires.
DataModel-absolute paths like @game/ReplicatedStorage/..., supported natively by Roblox. Requires a Rojo project file to map the filesystem to the DataModel.
require-on-rails.explicitPathStyle.description: Explicit mode only: the form written when RequireOnRails completes or rewrites a require path.

require-on-rails.preferRelativePaths.description: Explicit mode only: when the relative form of a path has strictly fewer segments than the configured explicitPathStyle form, write the relative form instead.

require-on-rails.rojoProjectPath.description: Explicit mode only: workspace-relative path of the Rojo project file used to map files to DataModel paths for the 'game' path style. Only used when no sourcemap is found at sourcemapPath. Glob $path values and globIgnorePaths are not supported.

require-on-rails.sourcemapPath.description: Explicit mode only: workspace-relative path of a Rojo-generated sourcemap, the preferred source for mapping files to DataModel paths for the 'game' path style. Falls back to rojoProjectPath when the file is missing. Keep 'rojo sourcemap --watch' running so newly created files stay resolvable.

require-on-rails.startsImmediately.description: Whether to start the extension as soon as vscode finishes loading.

require-on-rails.tryToAddImportRequire.description: Whether or not the system will try to add the contextual import generator statement automatically when you open a file that is missing it.

require-on-rails.enableAbsolutePathUpdat.description: Whether to prompt for updating absolute require paths when files are moved between different alias directories.

require-on-rails.enableFileNameCollision.description: Whether to detect and handle filename collisions by automatically renaming files with '_Duplicate' suffix.

require-on-rails.enableBasenameUpdates.description: Whether to prompt for updating basename require statements when files are renamed.

require-on-rails.importOpacity.description: The opacity of the require override in the editor.

require-on-rails.importModulePaths.description: The valid values for the `require` override. This is used to generate the contextual import statements. Uses the first value in the array as the default import path if one is not found.

require-on-rails.contextualImportTemplat.description: Template used when inserting contextual import code. Must include {IMPORT_MODULE_PATH} placeholder.

enumDescriptions: Place import at the very top of the file
Place import before the first require statement
Place import after Roblox service definitions (game:GetService calls)
require-on-rails.preferredImportPlacemen.description: Controls where the import require definition is placed when automatically added to files

require-on-rails.directoriesToScan.description: Directories to scan for generating Luau file aliases. Relative to the workspace root.

require-on-rails.ignoreDirectories.description: Regex patterns for directories/files to ignore when scanning for Luau files to generate aliases. By default uses '^_.*' to ignore anything prefixed with an underscore.

require-on-rails.manualAliases.description: Manual aliases for absolute path support. Maps alias names to their corresponding directory paths (relative to workspace root).

require-on-rails.pathPriority.description: Ordered path prefixes used to resolve ambiguous auto-generated aliases. Earlier entries are higher priority. An ambiguous basename is resolved only when exactly one candidate matches the highest-priority matched prefix; if multiple candidates match that same highest-priority prefix, it remains ambiguous.

require-on-rails.skipUpdateNotificationF.description: Version to skip update notifications for (set automatically when user clicks 'Don't Show Again')

require-on-rails.onAliasesRegenerated.description: Shell commands to run after aliases are regenerated. Each command is executed from the workspace root. Only commands set in your own User settings are ever run; if a workspace sets this, RequireOnRails ignores the commands and notifies you so you can review them and opt in.
